title: KiDS-Legacy: Joint analysis of second- and third-order cosmic shear (Linke et al.)
efc_relevance: First joint 2nd+3rd-order KiDS-Legacy cosmic-shear analysis (COSEBIs 2'-300' plus third-order aperture-mass moments 4'-32') that breaks the S8 = sigma8 (Omega_m/0.3)^0.5 degeneracy and constrains Omega_m and sigma8 independently — directly relevant to EFC's bifurcated S8 picture (DES Y6 low vs Combined-CMB high) tracked in arXiv:2602.12238 and to EFC's sealed P4 prediction, and tightens the pending_review_2026_05_01 KiDS-Legacy candidate row.
ledger_action: Add to Validation Ledger as S8 + non-Gaussian cosmic-shear anchor; promote pending_review_2026_05_01 KiDS-Legacy candidate to full items[] row; update cluster s8_tension_des_y6 with the higher-order-statistics dimension; cross-reference arXiv:2602.10065 (DES Y6) and arXiv:2605.13547 (UNIONS-3500).
